edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyNewOwner modifier requires msg.sender == newOwner before acceptOwnership executes.
newOwner is written from the _newOwner parameter.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to promote the pending owner.
acceptOwnership sets owner = newOwner, transferring full control.
pause is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
pause writes paused = true.
unpause writes paused = false.
transfer is gated by whenNotPaused and notFrozen(msg.sender).
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
transfer credits balances[_to] with _value.
transfer debits _value from balances[msg.sender].
transfer validates and mutates balances state.
transfer calls autoUnlock(msg.sender) when locks[msg.sender] is set.
transfer reads locks[msg.sender] to decide whether to auto-unlock.
transferFrom is gated by notFrozen(_from) and uses msg.sender as the spender.
transferFrom debits balances[_from] and credits balances[_to].
transferFrom validates and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender is the spender key used in the allowed mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
approve is gated by whenNotPaused and keys state on msg.sender.
approveAndCall forwards _spender into approve and the external call.
_extraData is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall invokes an external call on a caller-supplied contract address.
approveAndCall calls approve(_spender, _value) before the external call.
approveAndCall requires isContract(_spender) before calling out.
The external TokenRecipient can re-enter the token while approveAndCall is executing.
extcodesize result determines the isContract return value.
local size holds the extcodesize output inspected by isContract.
lock keys lockupInfo and balances on the _holder parameter.
lock subtracts _amount from balances[_holder].
lock stores _amount as the lockupBalance of lockupInfo[_holder].
_releaseStart is stored as lockupInfo[_holder].releaseTime.
_termOfRound is stored in lockupInfo[_holder].
_releaseRate is used to compute unlockAmountPerRound in lockupInfo[_holder].
lock requires _releaseStart > now, making behavior timestamp dependent.
getNowTime returns the timestamp, exposing time dependency to callers.
autoUnlock branches on lockupInfo[_holder].releaseTime <= now.
releaseTimeLock loop condition depends on now.
autoUnlock delegates release to releaseTimeLock.
releaseTimeLock reads lockupInfo rounds to compute release amounts.
releaseTimeLock mutates and deletes lockupInfo entries.
Release amounts are accumulated into the local releaseAmount.
releaseAmount is credited to balances[_holder].
releaseTimeLock requires locks[_holder] to be true.
releaseTimeLock clears locks[_holder] when the lockup completes.
The loop performs repeated SafeMath add/sub on lockupInfo balances in an unbounded loop.
Loop arithmetic rewrites lockupInfo.lockupBalance and releaseTime each iteration.
unlock operates on the _holder parameter supplied by the owner.
unlock reads lockupBalance and deletes lockupInfo[_holder].
unlock credits the whole lockupBalance back to balances[_holder].
distribute reads balances[owner] and recipient balances.
distribute debits balances[owner] and credits balances[_to].
distribute is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
distributeWithLockup calls distribute(_to, _value) first.
distributeWithLockup calls lock(_to, _value, _releaseStart, ...) afterwards.
claimToken performs an external token.transfer call on an owner-supplied ERC20 address.
claimToken is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
burn is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier and uses msg.sender as burner.
burn checks and decrements balances[msg.sender].
burn reduces totalSupply_ by _value.
burn writes the new balance of the burner.
local spender wraps _spender and receives the external receiveApproval call.
CSTToken constructor mints the whole supply to owner, which equals msg.sender.
Ownable constructor sets owner from msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
CSTToken constructor assigns balances[owner] = totalSupply_.
acceptOwnership compares the caller msg.sender against the stored newOwner.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner only exists to populate newOwner inside transferOwnership, so it collapses into that core function.
Recipient parameter _to is only used inside transfer's balance update.
Amount parameter _value is only used inside transfer's balance arithmetic.
Source parameter _from is only used inside transferFrom's balance and allowance updates.
Holder parameter _holder is only used to key lockupInfo and balances inside lock().
Amount parameter _amount is only consumed by lock() when creating the LockupInfo struct.
_releaseStart is only stored as lockupInfo.releaseTime inside lock().
_termOfRound is only stored into lockupInfo inside lock().
_releaseRate is only used to compute unlockAmountPerRound inside lock().
_spender is only used as the allowance key inside approve()/approveAndCall().
_extraData is only forwarded into the external receiveApproval call, an unsafe operation.
Local releaseAmount is only an accumulator inside releaseTimeLock's release loop.
Local size only holds the extcodesize result consumed by isContract().
Local spender only wraps _spender to perform the unsafe external call in approveAndCall.
